title: Classic Balsamic Vinaigrette
summary: A simple, glossy dressing balancing the sweetness of balsamic vinegar with a sharper vinegar and good olive oil.
equipment: jar with a lid for storing

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Measure
steps.text: Put 60 ml balsamic vinegar and 2 tbsp cider vinegar into a bowl.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Whisk in ½ tsp salt and ¼ tsp pepper until combined.

steps.title: Emulsify
steps.text: Pour in 160 ml olive oil in a slow stream, whisking constantly, until glossy and emulsified.

steps.title: Taste
steps.text: Taste on a leaf of salad and adjust the seasoning.

steps.title: Transfer
steps.text: Pour into a jar ready to store.

tips: Pour the oil in slowly while whisking constantly, so the dressing emulsifies rather than splitting.
Taste the dressing on a leaf of salad rather than from the spoon, as it will taste different once it coats the leaves.
Give the jar a good shake before each use, as the dressing will separate on standing.
storage: Store in a jar in the fridge for up to a week, shaking well before using. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
